fusions.name: Bolt and Boot
fusions.desc: Bolts up to 5 tiles to the target and kicks it for 13 damage, leaving it 14% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Alarm Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground and deals 5 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Startled Leap
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a stretch of ground, you restore 6 stamina. Once every 10 seconds.
